text:
If you're planning around dry windows today, keep your eye on the late morning and early afternoon, that's when the shower chances stack up. Officially it's a 40 percent day, high near 75, but there's real disagreement on how wet it gets. The American model wants to keep most of it dry, while the European model is much soggier, so I'd lean toward more scattered action than the bare number suggests, especially between 11 and 1. Sky clears to mostly sunny once that passes.

The lake is gentle today, south wind 5 to 10 knots and waves 1 to 3 feet, water still a swimmable 73. Tonight stays unsettled with more shower chances and a low around 56.

Tuesday looks like a repeat, chance of showers, high near 76, models split on just how wet again. Drier air is on the way by midweek. Good waterfront window today is late afternoon into early evening once the midday showers clear; keep the rain jacket handy through early afternoon.

week.blurb: Mostly sunny near 75, though the European model hints at more rain than the official call, so keep the umbrella handy.
Partly sunny and cooler near 76, with the Euro leaning wetter again, so don't put away the rain jacket.
Sunny and warmer, climbing to near 81 with light winds, the best day of the stretch.
Warm and humid near 84, with afternoon storms possible after 2, especially into the evening.
Showers and thunderstorms likely as a cold front clears through, high near 82, keep plans flexible.
Mostly sunny and comfortable near 78, a great day to be outside after the front.
Looks like mostly sunny skies near 80, with a slight chance of afternoon showers trending in later.
